name: nx glow
tagline: Your windows light up your wallpaper

artifacts.label: KDE Plasma effect + settings
artifacts.postInstallNote: After installation or an update, click Run setup (or open Settings > Install / repair effect). Setup builds against your KWin headers and asks for your system password. KDE Plasma 6.7 required; Arch/CachyOS dependencies are installed during setup. Before removing the Hub package, run ~/.local/share/nx-glow/uninstall.sh --gui to remove the system effect.
